checkpoint.title: after Gift RNG: save with the Eevee

events.why: the Eevee's summary Gift RNG left open, or HOME

checkpoint: Gift RNG takes the Eevee from its ball without moving the player and leaves its summary open, or HOME. This saves the shiny where 09.03 ended. A run started here with Gift RNG's handoff on loads the save facing the ball and runs Gift RNG first.
